prompt: `isValidEmail` in src/email.js rejects valid addresses such as `first.last+tag@sub.example.co.uk` and accepts invalid ones such as `a@b` and `a@@b.com`. Make it accept: a local part of letters, digits and . _ % + - (not starting or ending with a dot, no two dots in a row), one @, and a domain of two or more dot-separated labels (letters, digits, hyphens; a label does not start or end with a hyphen) whose last label is at least 2 letters. Run `node --test` (it finds test/*.test.mjs; on Node 24 `node --test test/` fails because a directory argument is not accepted). Only change src/email.js.
